title: Bind extension artifacts to checksums/signatures + quarantine (VC-201-076)
goal: VC-201-076 refuted: ExtensionManifest has no checksum/digest/signature fields — files map names to relative paths only; a declared `checksums` extra key is ignored by validate_manifest; a tampered admitted file reloads unchallenged (load_pack rechecks manifest shape only); tampering with a default-pack file is preserved as 'operator customization' and re-recorded as the new current digest rather than quarantined; ExtensionsState has only active/loaded/unloaded — no quarantine lane exists. Evidence: crates/susi-config/src/tests/vc_201_076_mastery.rs.
